function.name: verify_customer
function.description: Verifies customer identity against the account record using the last 4 digits of PAN or birth year before revealing any debt details. Must be called before any debt-related disclosure or tool.

account_id.description: The customer's unique account ID, e.g. ACC-88392

verification_code.description: The 4-digit PAN code or birth year provided by the user.

function.name: log_promise_to_pay
function.description: Logs the agreed promise-to-pay date and amount committed by the customer. Only call after verify_customer has returned verified:true in this call.

ptp_date.description: The ISO format date (YYYY-MM-DD) or descriptive date agreed upon for payment.

amount.description: The amount the customer agreed to pay.

function.name: send_payment_link
function.description: Triggers a payment link via SMS or WhatsApp to the customer's registered number. Only call after verify_customer has returned verified:true in this call.

function.name: escalate_to_agent
function.description: Routes a hardship or dispute case to a human agent queue and returns a ticket ID.

function.name: mark_disposition
function.description: Logs the final call outcome and disposition status in the database. Must be called exactly once before every call ends.
